name: Rishi Dhakar
summary:
Data-driven engineer with a strong background in data analysis, skilled in collecting, organizing, and analyzing data sets with meticulous
attention to detail and accuracy, transforming raw data into actionable insights.

• Reduce Silicon Standard Deviation in hot metal in G-blast furnace of Jamshedpur plant
Strategy • Pandas and Seaborn were used in Python to analyze, visualize the data and identify parameters affecting Si content
• Compared the best 5 and worst 5 days in terms of Si Standard Deviation to give actionable recommendations
Impact • Was able to predict Si content with 80% accuracy using Random Forest Regressor after hyperparameter tuning
• Recommended tolerance range for the 10 variables identified to keep Si Standard Deviation in check
